policies.sentence: AI misuse earns a zero or no credit on the assignment, exam or project.
Uncited AI use or missing AI documentation earns a zero.
AI misuse can lead to a failing grade for the assignment or the course.
AI misuse can lead to other grade reductions, including negative or escalating grade penalties.
AI misuse can bring academic sanctions, disciplinary action, reporting or expulsion.
Students who knowingly help others use AI to cheat also receive a penalty.
Time spent on work that is not the student's own project is removed.
